title: AI Generated Space Jam
author: moneydollarz
selftext:
Hey folks!

I’m hosting a little game jam and thought some of you might want to jump in, especially if you’ve been messing around with AI tools lately.

🌌 AI‑Generated Space Jam

The idea is simple… make a game where everything is created with the help of AI, code, art, music, writing, whatever you want to throw at it. If an AI tool can help you build it, it’s allowed.

🪐 Theme: Space Exploration

Pretty open‑ended. As long as your game involves exploring space in some way, you’re good.

⏳ Timeline

• Start: Jan 10, 2026

• End: Feb 15, 2026

So there’s plenty of time to experiment and let the AI tools do some heavy lifting.

Rules (pretty chill)

• Use AI tools for the bulk of development (art, code, audio, writing, etc.)

• Stick to the Space Exploration theme

If you’re into AI‑assisted dev or just want an excuse to build something fun, feel free to join in. Happy to answer questions too.

comments.author: CulturalFig1237
comments.body: The open theme plus a longer timeline makes this feel very approachable, especially for people still experimenting with AI workflows.

replies.author: moneydollarz
replies.body: I always make sure to give a month to allow everyone to experiment with the tools and see what others develop in that time frame
